questions.q: What is the IUPAC name of (CH₃)₂CHNH₂?
questions.explain: The –NH₂ is on the middle carbon (C-2) — propan-2-amine.
Two (identical) alkyl groups on N — a secondary simple amine.

questions.q: What is the hybridisation of nitrogen in amines?
questions.explain: Three bonds + one lone pair — sp³, pyramidal.

questions.q: Which method gives a pure primary amine?
questions.explain: The Gabriel synthesis gives no 2° or 3° amines.

questions.q: What does propanamide give in the Hoffmann bromamide degradation?
How is aniline obtained from benzamide?
Among compounds of similar molar mass, which has the highest boiling point?
questions.explain: The 1° amine has the most hydrogen bonding.

questions.q: Why do alcohols boil higher than amines of similar mass?
options: O–H···O bonds are stronger than N–H···N
questions.explain: Oxygen is more electronegative than nitrogen.

questions.q: Which is the strongest base in aqueous solution?
questions.explain: The aliphatic 2° amine has the lowest pKb (3.00).

questions.q: Why is aniline a weaker base than NH₃?
options: The lone pair is delocalised into the ring
questions.explain: The lone pair is less available for protonation.

questions.q: Which is the test for primary amines?
questions.explain: Only 1° amines give the foul-smelling isocyanide.

questions.q: With Hinsberg's reagent, the product of a primary amine is … in alkali?
questions.explain: The N–H is acidic, so it forms a soluble salt in alkali.
–NH₂ is strongly activating; all three o/p positions are substituted.

questions.q: Why does aniline not undergo the Friedel–Crafts reaction?
options: It forms a salt with AlCl₃ and the ring is deactivated
questions.explain: The Lewis acid AlCl₃ bonds to the N of aniline.

questions.q: What are the conditions of diazotisation of aniline?
questions.explain: At higher temperature the salt decomposes to phenol.
Hypophosphorous acid replaces the diazo group by H.

questions.q: What is formed in the coupling of a diazonium salt with phenol?
questions.explain: Electrophilic substitution at the para position; –N=N– gives colour.
